title: Data for "Degree-of-polarization modulation for high-dimensional optical computing"
text: This repository contains the MATLAB (.mat) files with the experimental and numerical data supporting the figures presented in the article: Alessandro Petrini, Claudio Conti, and Davide Pierangeli,Degree-of-polarization modulation for high-dimensional optical computing,Nature (2026).https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10891-z
